newsitem.title: USA: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-EAGLES SIGN FREE AGENT CENTER STEVE EVERITT.
newsitem.headline: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-EAGLES SIGN FREE AGENT CENTER STEVE EVERITT.

text.p: The Philadelphia Eagles Thursday announced the signing of free agent centre Steve Everitt, who had been with the Baltimore Ravens, to a five-year contract.
Financial terms were not disclosed, but ESPN reported the deal was worth $11 million and included a $2 million signing bonus. Everitt earned $785,000 last year with Baltimore.

The 26-year-old Everitt, who has developed into one of the league's top young centres, spent the first four years of his National Football League career with the Ravens -- formerly the Cleveland Browns.
The Ravens had designated Everitt as a transition player, giving them the right to match any offer, but removed the designation just before the start of the league's free agency period.
Everitt was a 1993 first-round draft pick out of Michigan.
